reading: age is encoded about equally in both blocks at this instrument's resolution, so no mask can remove it selectively and R3 is DEMOTED -- but receptive-field bleed shrinks this contrast toward zero, so this is a limit of the probe, NOT evidence that age is genuinely co-located
the escalation score tracks age read from peri-lesional skin more strongly than age read from the lesion
peri-lesional skin carries age more than it carries the diagnosis, so an exterior dropout would remove more nuisance than signal
lesion AREA alone predicts age band above chance -- part of what both blocks read is geometry, which no exterior dropout removes

exterior age AUC is FLAT in lesion area -- the interval on large-minus-small contains zero, and receptive-field bleed cannot produce a flat profile, since a larger lesion necessarily fills more of every exterior cell's receptive field. The exterior block is reading the surrounding skin, not an echo of the lesion.
